We're introducing Saved Views, a new way to organize how your team looks at work. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders every time you open a project, you can now save any custom view — filtered, sorted, and grouped exactly how you like it — and return to it with a single click. Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans, at no additional cost.

Each user can save up to 50 views, covering every project, filter combination, or workflow stage you track regularly. Whether you need a quick snapshot of overdue tasks, a weekly planning board, or a client-specific dashboard, your views are ready whenever you need them.

Saved Views also make collaboration easier. Any view you create can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered perspective without repeating setup steps. Once shared, teammates can open it directly and stay aligned on priorities.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
